sessions.title: Every session, live
sessions.description: Your Claude Code sessions land here the moment they start. Try this: open Sessions and pick one to watch it unfold in real time.

workflows.title: See the whole agent tree
workflows.description: Main agents, subagents, handoffs — all mapped as one workflow. Try this: open Workflows and trace an agent's swim lane end to end.

run.title: Launch a run without leaving Podium
run.description: Spawn a Claude Code session right from the dashboard, no terminal switch required. Try this: hit Run Claude and kick one off.

ccConfig.title: Your Claude setup, mapped
ccConfig.description: Agents, hooks, MCP servers, permissions — everything Claude Code loads, in one place. Try this: open Claude Config and inspect what's wired up.

settings.title: Tune it to how you work
settings.description: Notifications, pricing, hooks, data — all the knobs live here. Try this: open Settings and turn on notifications so you never miss a failed run.

settingsEntry.title: Onboarding tour
settingsEntry.description: Replay the guided tour of Podium's main sections.

header.title: Your session at a glance
header.description: Name, live status, model, and elapsed time all sit right here. The status badge tracks whether the run is still active, and a red error chip only shows up when something actually went wrong.

headerActions.title: Note, share, refresh
headerActions.description: Jot a private note on this session, export it as JSON or copy a shareable link, and force a refresh if the data ever looks stale.

tabs.title: Four ways to read this session
tabs.description: Agents shows who ran and in what order. Conversation replays the transcript like a chat. Thinking surfaces the model's extended reasoning. Timeline is the raw, filterable event feed.

agentTree.title: Who ran, and in what order
agentTree.description: Each row is one agent — the main agent on top, subagents nested underneath. Click a row with children to expand its subagents, or click a leaf agent to jump straight to its conversation.

conversation.title: The conversation, replayed
conversation.description: Every message and tool call from the transcript, in the order it happened. Pick a different agent from the Agents tab to switch which conversation is shown here.

runSummary.title: The finished run at a glance
runSummary.description: Once a session completes, expand this card to see total cost, duration, tool calls, errors, and files touched — no need to dig through the timeline for the headline numbers.
